title: Review a draft Form 1040 — Jordan Blake
instructions: Jordan Blake (single, age 40, no dependents) gave you the source documents below. Review the draft 2025 return prepared by a staff accountant. Tick each amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount. Jordan doesn't itemize.

exhibits.title: Source documents
exhibits.content:
- Form W-2: wages **$85,000**; no employer HSA contributions.
- Form 1099-INT: bank interest **$1,200**; municipal bond interest **$800** (box 8).
- Form 1099-DIV: qualified dividends **$2,000**.
- Form 5498-SA: Jordan contributed **$3,000** to an HSA from personal funds; Jordan had qualifying high-deductible coverage all year.
- Alimony paid under a divorce decree executed in **2017**: **$6,000**.
- 2025 standard deduction, single: **$15,750**.

exhibits.title: Draft return
exhibits.content:
| Line | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Wages | 85,000 |
| Taxable interest | 2,000 |
| Qualified dividends | 2,000 |
| Adjustments to income (alimony) | 6,000 |
| AGI | 83,000 |
| Standard deduction | 15,000 |
| **Taxable income** | **68,000** |

rows.label: Taxable interest
rows.explanation: Municipal bond interest (800) is excluded: taxable interest is **1,200**.

rows.label: Adjustments to income
rows.explanation: Alimony under a 2017 decree (6,000) plus the HSA contribution made outside an employer plan (3,000) = **9,000**.

reviewNote: Uses the 2025 standard deduction of $15,750 set by P.L. 119-21; confirm against current IRS guidance.
